title: Indian-Style Tomato Curry
description: A vibrant and flavorful Indian-inspired curry made with fresh tomatoes and spices. Serve over rice or with naan bread.

ingredients.name: vibrant oil
ingredients.notes: such as coconut or olive oil

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add curry powder and garam masala. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they start to break down, about 5 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
